content: Kawoy, “Ba na7aa Abeseloomes yeekesinne zeleeles” yaagidi Iyo7aabas odidosona.
Kawoy ba na7aas yeekeysa si7ida gisho, he gallas enti ubbay xoonida xoonoy yeehon laametis.
Olape baqatidi yeellan guye simmida olanchoda he gallas asay doona pogonna katama gelidosona.
Kawoy guuluntidi, ba qaala dhoqu oothidi, “Yii, ta na7aw Abeseloome! Yii, ta na7aw! Abeseloome yii!” yaagidi zeleelis.
Hessafe guye, Iyo7aabi kawa soo bidi, “Nena, ne adde nayta, ne macca nayta, ne machetanne ne laggethota ashshida ne asa ubbaa hachi neeni kawushadasa.

Nena ixeyisata neeni dosaasa; nena doseyisata neeni ixaasa. Ne olanchotinne enta halaqati new aykoka gidonnaysa neeni hachi qoncisadasa. Nuuni ubbay hayqin, Abeseloomey hachi paxa attidaako neeni ufaytanaysa ta be7as.

Ha77i denda! Kare keyada ne asaa minthetha. Ta Godaa sunthan caaqayis; neeni keyonna ixiko, hachi qamma neera issi asika attenna. Na7atethafe hachi gakanaw nena gakida iita ubbaafe haysi new aadhida iita gidana” yaagis.
Dawiti Yerusalaame Simmis
Hessa gisho, kawoy dendidi pengiya matan uttis. Kawoy pengen uttidaysa asa ubbay si7ida wode kawako yidosona. He wode Isra7eele asa ubbay banta soo soo baqatidosona.

Isra7eele kochati ubbay issoy issuwara haysada yaagidi palamidosona; “Kawoy Dawiti nuna nu morketa kushepe ashshis; nuna Filisxeemeta kushepe wosisis; shin I ha77i Abeseloome gaason biitta aggidi baqatis.
Nu bolla kawotanaada nuuni tiyida Abeseloomey olan hayqis. Yaatin, kawa guye ehanaba hinte ayis si77i gidetii?” yaagidosona.
Kawoy Dawiti kahineta Saadoqanne Abyataara kiittidi, Yihuda cimatako haysada yaagis; “Isra7eele asa ubbay odetiya oday kawa gakis. Yaatin, kawa iya gadho zaari ehanaw hinte ayis guye atteetii?
Hinte ta ishata; hinte ta ashonne ta suuthu. Yaatin, kawa guye zaari ehanaw hinte ayis haratape guye atteetii?” yaagis.
Qassi Dawiti Amaasako, “Neeni ta ashonne ta suuthu gidikii? Hachife doomin, taani nena Iyo7aaba bessan ta tora mocona oothonna ixiko, Xoossi tana pirdo” yaagis.
I Yihuda asa ubbaa wozanaa issino oothidi shammis. Hessa gisho, enti kawako kiittidi, “Neera ne asaara ubbay haa simmite” yaagidosona.
Kawoy simmidi, Yordaanose shaafa gakanaw yis. Yihuda asay kawa Yordaanose shaafa pinthanaw Galgala bidosona.
Biraqima addey, Biniyaame kochay, Geera na7ay Saami Dawita mokanaw ellesidi Yihuda asaara bis.
Iyara Biniyaame koche gidida mukulu asay, Saa7ola aylley Siibi, tammanne ichashu iya naytinne laatamu aylleti iyara de7oosona. Enti kawoy de7iya bessaa Yordaanose shaafa dirgishe bidosona.
Kawa soo asaa ehanawunne kawa ufaysiyabaa oothanaw pinniya bessaara pinnidosona. Geera na7ay Saami Yordaanose shaafa pinnida wode kawa sinthan gufannidi,
“Kawaw ta nagaraa taybopa. Ta goday, kawoy, Yerusalaamepe keyiya wode taani ne aylley qohida qohuwa hassayopa. Hesaa ne ulon oykofa.
Ne aylley taani nagara oothidaysa erayis; shin ta godaa, kawa mokanaw Yoosefa soo asa
ubbaafe koyrottada taani hachi yas” yaagis.
Xaruya na7ay Abisi, “Saami Goday tiyida kawa baaddida gisho hayqanaw besseneyee?” yaagis.
Dawiti Abisako, “Hinteno, Xaruya nayto, hintena gathiyabay aybee? Hinte hachi taw morke gideeti! Hachi Isra7eelen ay asika hayqenna! Hachi Isra7eele kawoy tana!” yaagis.
Kawoy Saami, “Ne hayqaka” yaagidi caaqis.
Qassi Saa7ola na7ay Mempibostey kawa mokanaw duge wodhis. Kawoy bida gallasape doomidi I saron guye simmiya gallas gakanaw Mempibostey ba tohuwanne ba ma7uwa meeccibeenna; ba buuchaa meedibeenna.
Mempibostey kawuwara gahetanaw Yerusalaamepe yida wode kawoy, “Mempiboste, neeni taara ayis babikii?” yaagidi oychis.
Mempibostey, “Ta godaw kawaw, taani ne aylley sila gidiya gisho ‘Taani toggada kawuwara baana mela ta hariya koora’ yaagas. Shin ta aylley Siibi tana cimmis.
Ta godaa, kawas wordo odidi ta sunthaa iissis. Neeni ta goday, kawoy Xoossa kiitancho mela gidiya gisho nena lo77idaba ootha.
Ta aawa soo asa ubbay hayqanaw bessees, shin taani ne aylley ne gaytape meysatara maana mela taw besse immadasa. Yaatin, hessafe aadhiyaba kawa oychanaw taw ay maati de7ii?” yaagis.
Kawoy zaaridi, “Neeni darobaa odetanaw koshshenna. Neera Siibara gadiya shaaketidi ekana mela kiittas” yaagis.
Mempibostey, “Ta goday, kawoy saro soo simmaafe attishin, ubbay Siibas gido” yaagis.
Galada addey Barziley kawuwara issife Yordaanose pinnidi iya moyzanaw Roogalimape yis.
Barziley laythi hospun tammu gidida cima asi. I daro dure gidiya gisho kawoy Mahanayma kataman de7iya wode kawas koshshiyaba immis.
Kawoy iyako, “Neeni taara Yerusalaame yedha; taani new koshshiyaba immana” yaagis.
Shin Barziley, “Taani hizape daro laythi de7ike; taani kawuwara Yerusalaame ayis boo?

Taani ha77i hospun tammu laytha asi; taani iitanne lo77o shaakada eranaw danda7iyana? Taani ne aylley ta miyabaanne uyaaba mal7uwa shaakada eranaw danda7iyana? Taani addenne macca yethi shaakada si7anaw danda7iyana? Yaatin, taani ne aylley, ta godaw kawaw ayis tooho gido?
Taani ne aylley nena Yordaanose pinthana. Shin kawoy taw kushe zaaranaw ayis koshshii?
Taani ta aawanne ta aaye duufuwa matan ta kataman hayqana mela simmayis. Ne aylley Kimihaami haysish; ta godaa, kawuwara I boo; nena ufaysiyabaa iyaw ootha” yaagis.
Kawoy, “Kimihaami taara pinno; nena ufaysiyabaa taani iyaw oothana. Qassi neeni tana oychiyaba ayba gidikoka taani new oothana” yaagis.
Hessafe guye, asa ubbay Yordaanose pinnidosona; kawoyka pinnis. Kawoy Barzile yeeridi anjis; Barziley ba soo simmis.
Kawoy Yordaanose pinnidi Galgala biya wode Kimihaami iyara issife bis. Yihuda olanchoti ubbaynne Isra7eele olanchotape baggati kawuwara bidosona.
Isra7eele ubbay kawako bidi, “Nu ishati, Yihuda asay kawanne iya soo asaa qosidi, iya asaara issife Yordaanose ayis pinthidona?” yaagidosona.
Yihuda asay, “Nuuni hessa oothiday kawoy nuus mata dabbo gidiya gishosa. Yaatin, hinte hessas ayis yilotetii? Nuuni kawuwape ayko mido? Woyko nuuni iyape ayko ekido?” yaagidosona.

Isra7eele asay, “Kawuwape tammu kushey nuusa; Dawita matan nuus hintefe aadho maati de7ees! Yaatin, hinte nuna ayis kadhidetii? Kawa guye zaaridi ehanaw koyrottidi odiday nuna gidoko?” yaagidosona. Shin Isra7eele asaape Yihuda asay daro wolqanthidi haasayidosona.

footnotes.text: : Woyko pudeha baggan de7iya Isra7eele zeretha ubbaafe guussu.
